D CORE 1.25G BiDi SFP Module TX1310nm/RX1550nm LC Single-Mode 20KM

The D CORE 1.25G BiDi SFP Module offers high-speed and reliable data transmission over single-mode fiber using a bidirectional (BiDi) optical design. With a TX wavelength of 1310nm and RX at 1550nm, this module transmits data efficiently through a single fiber strand. Featuring an LC connector and supporting distances up to 20KM, it is ideal for enterprise networks, ISPs, and data centers requiring compact and cost-effective fiber connectivity.

Key Features:

  • Data Rate: 1.25Gbps Gigabit Ethernet

  • Wavelength: TX 1310nm / RX 1550nm

  • Connector Type: LC, BiDi (Single Fiber)

  • Fiber Type: Single-Mode (SMF)

  • Transmission Distance: Up to 20KM

  • Hot-pluggable SFP form factor

  • Low power consumption and high reliability

  • Made in China
  • 1-Year (Replacement Warranty)

Ensure seamless long-range fiber communication with the D CORE 1.25G BiDi LC SFP Module, compatible with a wide range of switches and routers that support SFP transceivers.
